leftEvidence.title: Uncleansed people eat Passover and are healed

points.label: Cleansing setting and claim
points.left: Uncleansed participants eat Passover contrary to the written order while Hezekiah prays and healing is reported.
points.right: Peter describes God cleansing Gentile hearts by faith while arguing against placing a yoke on them.

points.left: Uncleansed participants eat Passover contrary to the written order while Hezekiah prays and healing is reported.

payload.posture: Both sources face people whose access is challenged by expected purification boundaries.

rightEvidence.title: Peter says Gentile hearts were cleansed by faith

payload.tension: Hezekiah prays for participants who lacked prescribed purification; Acts argues that God cleansed Gentile hearts by faith.
